title: FoSellwands
description: Sell wand tools for quick container selling and shop payouts.
body:
![FoSellwands cover image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SsuVuDuW/images/12b3a0b28145cf49f5dfd43072d118ca0a2c3715.png)

FoSellwands gives your server configurable sellwands that sell container contents through your existing shop prices and pay players through Vault. Players can inspect value before selling, use limited or unlimited wand tiers, and staff can tune the whole flow from an in-game editor.

## Features
- Sell enabled containers such as chests, barrels, hoppers, and shulker boxes with a wand click, including nested shulker or bundle contents when enabled.
- Use FoShop first and ShopGUIPlus as a fallback, so payouts follow your real shop prices instead of a separate sellwand price list.
- Create tiered or custom sellwands with configurable materials, glow, custom model data, multipliers, uses, names, lore, and tracked sold stats.
- Let players preview container value, require confirmation when needed, and show configurable sale breakdowns after a sale.
- Manage tiers, container types, click modes, cooldowns, permissions, sale feedback, holograms, and logging from the in-game editor.
- Keep selling safer with Vault payout rollback, optional WorldGuard access checks, sale history logs, wand crafting/editing guards, and AxSellwands item conversion.

![Container selector for sellwand-enabled storage blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SsuVuDuW/images/f130880f588c26c127f257a97107026b708f616e.png)

## Dependencies
- `Vault` - Required for economy payouts.
- `FoShop` or `ShopGUIPlus` - Used as the sell-price source. FoShop is checked first by default, with ShopGUIPlus available as a fallback.
- `WorldGuard` - Optional protection hook for container access checks.

## Commands
- `/fosellwandsadmin editor` - Open the in-game editor.
- `/fosellwandsadmin reload` - Reload config, messages, GUI, dialog, and sellwand files.
- `/fosellwandsadmin version` - Check the installed version and latest Modrinth version.
- `/fosellwandsadmin list` - List configured sellwand tiers.
- `/fosellwandsadmin give <player> <tier> [amount]` - Give a configured sellwand tier.
- `/fosellwandsadmin give <player> <multiplier> <uses> [amount]` - Give a custom sellwand.

## Permissions
- `fosellwands.admin` - Allows managing FoSellwands, including the editor, reload, version, list, and give commands.
- `fosellwands.use` - Allows players to use sellwands.
- `fosellwands.use.<tier>` - Allows a specific sellwand tier when per-tier permissions are enabled, such as `fosellwands.use.basic`, `fosellwands.use.rare`, or `fosellwands.use.legendary`.
